headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment Certification on Listed SRCD
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited has certified to NSE/BSE its timely payment of interest on publicly-issued Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures, in compliance with SEBI Regulation 57 disclosure obligations.
implication: Routine Regulation 57 intimation evidences continuous covenant compliance on listed debt securities; material only if payment default or delay had occurred or is anticipated - flagged as precedent for monitoring issuer covenant discipline on public debenture tranches.
detail: Under SEBI's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (LODR) Regulations 2015, Regulation 57 mandates that listed companies certify timely servicing of debt obligations to stock exchanges. This filing by Sammaan Capital confirms interest payment on SRCD securities issued via public offering and listed on stock exchanges (NSE and/or BSE). Such certifications are routine operational compliance milestones; their value lies in early-warning absence or late filing, which would signal debt service stress.
